title: Rating rank within each movie
statementMd:
Rank each review within its movie from highest rating to lowest with `RANK()`. Show movie id, reviewer, rating, rank. Only for movies with at least three reviews. Order by movie id, rank, reviewer.

Expected columns: `movie_id`, `reviewer`, `rating`, `rk`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Window `RANK()` partitioned by movie; filter on a count window.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT movie_id, reviewer, rating, rk FROM (SELECT movie_id, reviewer, rating, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY movie_id ORDER BY rating DESC) AS rk, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY movie_id) AS n FROM reviews) WHERE n >= 3 ORDER BY movie_id, rk, reviewer;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
